summary: Scar Mountain lookout cab on the summit, built 1926 in Linn County, Oregon; staffed in the 1930s; removed 1965; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: D-5 style lookout house (a cab on the summit); no tower is described
facts.status_note: Cab removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed. No source describes remains at the site

events.note: Built 1926 atop the southwesternmost of two summits; a D-5 style lookout house per the Forest Lookouts history
George Brock stationed as lookout on Scar Mountain (Oregon Statesman, August 1933)
Elmer Klutke named as ranger and lookout on Scar Mountain (Daily Capital Journal, September 1935)
June 1936 item says Klutke will be located on Scar Mountain that summer; planned posting, not confirmed by a later source
1955 survey description places a marker 25 feet south of a Forest Service lookout house on top of the mountain
Register and Forest Lookouts history say the cab or lookout house was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register on May 12, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: The NGS marker description and the Forest Lookouts page both give Linn County, and firelookout.com says Linn County. The register's Lane County entry is the outlier.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Lane County; firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say Linn. The story and proposed correction use Linn; the register's entry is kept as a disputed source.

The register says the cab was removed in 1965, firelookout.com says destroyed, and the Forest Lookouts page says the lookout house was removed. The record keeps removed 1965 because two sources agree on removal and the third names no other method.
firelookout.com gives about 12 miles south of Detroit; the 1955 US Geological Survey station description gives about 13.5 miles SSE. The story reports both; neither is treated as settled.

notes_for_editor: Three sources, one of them a transcription page that quotes newspapers and a 1955 survey description. The register and firelookout.com agree on the 1926 build; the register and the Forest Lookouts page agree on 1965 removal. Access is not recorded: no source says whether the summit can be visited, so the access key is omitted rather than set to unknown. The brief's height is absent and no source gives one. The Scar Mountain Trail #3402 on the Willamette NF site runs along the same ridge but no source ties it to the lookout site, so it is not cited. Not read: the Oregon Historic Sites or heritagedata pages for Scar Mountain. The 1936 posting is a plan, not a confirmed staffing record.
